result.verdict: VALIDATED: the numeric complex Wick engine reproduces the exact real-saddle ladder kappa_1..kappa_5 to >30 digits, passes the Stirling control, and — extended to the tilted saddle s*(mu) — gives a real tower at real meridian (Im 𝔙 = 0, matching the corpus gluing solver and the amphichirality) and a complex tower at mu = i*eps whose leading response d𝔙/dmu = 5/6 confirms the linear-tilt parametrization. The higher complex fluctuation orders at mu = i*eps are emitted as new output — the higher-order partners of the i*t*kappa_1 finite-b correction already in the corpus. This wires the deformed saddle into the C6 generator geometrically; the meridian<->Q_beta map stays the OPEN bridge (no mu fixed from QOU data). Anti-laundering: 4_1 geometric facts; NO fit; NO c_k wired; NO tier change.
